title: Raise module-governance-real spec budget above its own retry budget
goal: Eliminate the timeout-inverted flake where the 30s config-level test timeout cannot contain the spec's internal retry budget (toPass 60s / goto 90s from #246/#284) during the real generate→register→purge cycle on 2-vCPU CI runners.
statusNote: 2026-09-22: fix merged on main as PR #325 (merge commit 99f63086). Local real-flow verification passed (1 passed, 10.9s) against a node-capable backend; the 8080 node/PATH issue is an environment gap, not a product defect. Full hosted smoke remains the final runner-specific confirmation.

in: Budget comment explaining the timeout inversion
out: Shaving or removing the spec's retry block

description: Fix module-governance-real.spec.ts CI flake caused by inverted timeout budget; pattern follows tenant-hostile-browser-matrix.spec.ts
acceptance_criteria: test budget (120s) exceeds the spec's own retry budget (60s toPass + 90s goto)
Real-flow smoke passes locally against a live backend
Full Smoke Suite green on the PR
verification_commands: cd frontend && node scripts/run-smoke-suite.mjs --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --cleanup-fixtures all --config playwright.config.ts -- tests/smoke/business/generated/module-governance-real.spec.ts
runtimeNotes: Verification surfaced an environment finding: the maintainer-started 8080 backend lacks node in PATH, so /lowcode/generator/preview-files returns 500 module.generate.server_export_failed there (exec.LookPath fails in backend/internal/scaffold/workspace.go). Same exporter + a second backend with PANTHEON_NODE_BIN set both succeed. Not a code defect; maintainer-side restart with node on PATH (or PANTHEON_NODE_BIN) resolves it.
